correctness.rationale: For cylinder fixed points with angular increment 2pi*m, p=2pi*m and sin(theta)=2pi(1-b)m/K. Jacobian J=[[1+c,b],[c,b]] has det=b and trace=1+b+c, so second-order Schur test -2(1+b)<c<0 admits exactly the negative-cosine branch when 0<K^2-[2pi(1-b)m]^2<4(1+b)^2. The open squared-integer windows m^2<t<m^2+W encode every winding. Any q distinct positive windings have squared span >=q^2-1; simultaneous +/-1..+/-q attain if W>q^2-1; including zero yields odd threshold W>q^2. The largest open-window counts and the exact ceiling expression follow, attained away from endpoints. Both neutral +/-1 boundaries excluded. Independently enumerated exact-rational endpoints and interval midpoints for eight widths W=1/5,9/10,1,17/10,3,4,81/10,100; results matched formula; finite checks do not establish every real b.
residual_risks: Only hyperbolic period-one sinks, unwrapped cylinder momentum, zero torque and 0<b<1; not a claim about higher-period attractors or neutral-point nonlinear asymptotic stability.
